contents: A roguelike plate game based around surviving random events.
Survive events that raise the intensity, unlocking more and more severe events.
Collect Clocks to deduct Time, the primary goal for the next Cycle that also gives Cyclathrons.
Cyclathrons (€) is a shared currency used to purchase Cards, earned from Clocks or other means.
Cards can either be beneficial, harmful or both, dedicated to a category (Upgrades and Curses), with different behaviour.

Survivors have unique abilities, tailored to a style with different stats.

There are several vanilla changes (0.6x Air Drag, locked Breaking & Building).

Now lets play the game gang.
If you have downloaded from Modrinth, you may find the Discord link on the page to send feedback or to see updates on the game.
